excerpts.author: ncitron
excerpts.content:
Hi all. Wanted to share a new light client I've been working on, Helios:
https://github.com/a16z/helios

It exposes most of the eth jsonrpc much like Kevlar

excerpts.author: ralexstokes
excerpts.content: <@171102499057565697> this looks awesome!

excerpts.author: ralexstokes
excerpts.content: looks like you are open to contributors and i intend to send some from the EPF your way

excerpts.author: ralexstokes
excerpts.content: was just about to start roadmapping out something along these lines, would love to collaborate on this

excerpts.author: shresth
excerpts.content: its kinda crazy that you literally ported the Kevlar code including the same commit messages

excerpts.author: ncitron
excerpts.content: Really? As you can see, I've been working on Helios since August (long before Kevlar's release)

excerpts.author: ncitron
excerpts.content: Haven't even looked at the code

excerpts.author: ncitron
excerpts.content: Although I do shoutout Kevlar in the blog post

excerpts.author: excib
excerpts.content: This is awesome. Saw it on Farcaster. Our dev is already taking a look at it to assess for use on our ethOS mobile operating system.

excerpts.author: ncitron
excerpts.content: That's amazing

excerpts.author: ncitron
excerpts.content: Looking forward to your contributions!

excerpts.author: shresth
excerpts.content: I think its just co incidentally that the commit message look very much alike

excerpts.author: shresth
excerpts.content: Any ways amazing work! Happy to see any progress made in the direction

excerpts.author: shresth
excerpts.content: Would love to collaborate as well

excerpts.author: ncitron
excerpts.content: Thanks! Awesome to see lots of people working on light clients these days

excerpts.author: philngo
excerpts.content: I've added this project to our notion project showcase page. What's the best way for potential collaborators to reach out to you?

excerpts.author: ncitron
excerpts.content: We have a telegram group linked in the repo, and folks can reach me on tg @ ncitron

excerpts.author: dionyziz
excerpts.content: <@171102499057565697> Very cool that we worked on the same problem independently on Kevlar with <@563394111214714881> ! We should compare notes. Congratulations on the launch!

excerpts.author: ncitron
excerpts.content: Definitely! Might also be a good idea to start thinking about ways in which eth1/eth2 can change to support light clients better together.

excerpts.author: dionyziz
excerpts.content: Yes we have an EIP in the works.

excerpts.author: shresth
excerpts.content: QQ <@171102499057565697> How do you do eth_call and eth_estimateGas?

excerpts.author: shresth
excerpts.content: Do you sequentially fetch storage slots during the local EVM simulation?

excerpts.author: ncitron
excerpts.content: Not quite. I first fetch an access list, then fetch state in parallel, then simulate the call (and sequentially fetch state in cases where its missing from the access list)

excerpts.author: shresth
excerpts.content: great, thats same for Kevlar

excerpts.author: ncitron
excerpts.content: Seems we are on the same wavelength lol

excerpts.author: shresth
excerpts.content: yaah

excerpts.author: shresth
excerpts.content: wanted to recommend you the accesslist trick lol, seems you already got it right

excerpts.author: ncitron
excerpts.content: I figured that one out when trying to access the uniswap frontend, and getting merked by a giant multicall to fetch 200+ token balances

excerpts.author: shresth
excerpts.content: ha ha, the Uniswap frontend does nasty calls indeed

excerpts.author: uink45
excerpts.content: Hey nice work! Does this require running a full node?

excerpts.author: shresth
excerpts.content: we used it as well to test it

excerpts.author: ncitron
excerpts.content: It requires using a full node, but you don't need to trust it

excerpts.author: shresth
excerpts.content: you need to have access to some RPC and beacon api but you don't have to run it yourself

excerpts.author: uink45
excerpts.content: Is the next approach to use the Libp2p specification for light clients in 'Consensus Specs' for automatic syncing?

excerpts.author: ncitron
excerpts.content: Yeah I have yet to implement the p2p stuff. It's on the list, but it's a daunting task

excerpts.author: ncitron
excerpts.content: For now I just use the beacon api

excerpts.author: uink45
excerpts.content: Sounds good, yeah definitely there are a lot of moving parts to it!
